about: Which model the exercise calls, and how. provider: 'auto' calls Databricks when the notebook runs in Databricks (or DATABRICKS_HOST is set) and the scripted stand-in otherwise; 'databricks' always calls Databricks; 'stand-in' never calls a model. endpoint: a Databricks Foundation Model API endpoint that supports tool calling. reasoning_effort: how hard the model thinks before it answers; null sends none.
